cases.description: R16 weak-pull-up enable compatibility: reset, configured host, pull-up release
measures: .meas tran en_reset_max MAX v(en) FROM=0 TO=4m
.meas tran en_enabled_min MIN v(en) FROM=6m TO=14m
.meas tran en_release_max MAX v(en) FROM=16m TO=20m
.meas tran old_en_max MAX v(old_en) FROM=6m TO=14m
cases.todo: Require EN enabled >=2.0V and reset/release <=0.66V for specified-leakage silicon; inspect A2 E9 separately. Pull capacitance is illustrative. Stock firmware never releases pull-up during suspend; this release test is an electrical envelope only.
